messages.subject: Project Skylark - EXECUTED Licence Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Pleased to confirm the Patent and Technology Licence Agreement has been executed today, 14 November 2024. The executed PDF is attached for your records. Key dates: upfront fee of £4,500,000 due by 28 November; technology transfer (Schedule 2) to be completed within 30 days.

Congratulations to both teams.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
